_comment: Version-bump recipe read by cut-release (see ~/.claude/skills/cut-release), which replaced /bump and /release on 2026-08-13. Source of truth is src/finbreak/__init__.py __version__. 'files' are mechanical exact-string edits; the CHANGELOG entry cuts the accumulated [Unreleased] block into a dated section (bodies are authored during dev via changelog_log, so no todo is needed). post_check asserts every version-bearing file agrees. README.md's 'Current version' line is bumped mechanically (files) and drift-gated (post_check); its feature/'what's new' prose is refreshed via a todo at bump time so it stays layman-friendly (user directive 2026-07-12). NOTE: this recipe covers the version bump only -- the signed AppImage build + publish is a separate manual step. Run scripts/release-linux.sh, then scripts/release-windows.sh: they build, sign, verify against RELEASE_PUBLIC_KEY_B64 and attach all eight assets, and each refuses to report success on an incomplete set (CLAUDE.md § Cutting a release). Never publish by hand: a hand-run gh release create is how releases shipped with two of their eight files (FIBR-0203, FIBR-0387).
post_check: V=$(sed -n 's/^__version__ = "\([0-9.]*\)"/\1/p' src/finbreak/__init__.py); test -n "$V" && grep -q "^version = \"$V\"$" pyproject.toml && grep -q "__version__ == \"$V\"" tests/test_smoke.py && grep -q "^## \[$V\] - " CHANGELOG.md && grep -qF "Current version: **$V**" README.md && grep -q "release version=\"$V\"" packaging/obs/io.github.milnet01.finbreak.metainfo.xml && grep -q "^finbreak ($V)" packaging/obs/debian/changelog && grep -q "tag: v$V" packaging/flatpak/io.github.milnet01.finbreak.yaml && grep -qF "<param name=\"revision\">v$V</param>" packaging/obs/_service && echo "version lockstep OK: $V" || { echo "VERSION DRIFT: expected $V across __init__.py, pyproject.toml, tests/test_smoke.py, README.md, a dated CHANGELOG section, the metainfo <release>, the deb changelog, the Flatpak git tag, and the OBS revision"; exit 1; }
todos: Refresh README.md for v{NEW} so it stays LAYMAN-FRIENDLY (plain language, no jargon): update the feature list / 'what's new' wording to reflect the user-visible changes in the new [{NEW}] CHANGELOG section. The 'Current version' line is bumped mechanically by the files step (so just confirm it reads {NEW}); this todo is only the prose. Keep it short and outcome-focused -- what the app now does for the user, not how it works internally. ALSO sweep the standing status sections for staleness even when NO CHANGELOG line names them (they drift between releases): the **Code signing** note, the per-platform **Install** notes and their auto-update claims (Windows / macOS / Linux), and the distribution channels -- verify each against reality (roadmap ship-status, the actual release assets, whether SignPath/Authenticode is active). User directive 2026-07-23: ensure README.md is up to date on EVERY release, not just the feature list.

Sync the AppStream metainfo (FIBR-0155): prepend a `<release version="{NEW}" date="{TODAY}">` block to packaging/obs/io.github.milnet01.finbreak.metainfo.xml, generated from the new [{NEW}] CHANGELOG section via the changelog-writer agent (Mode A: CHANGELOG section -> AppStream <release> XML). The newest <release> must equal __version__ (obs_packaging INV-6); post_check now gates this.

Re-pin the Flatpak git source (FIBR-0159): the manifest's `tag:` is bumped mechanically by the files step (and gated by post_check), but its sibling `commit:` cannot be -- the tag's sha does not exist until the release is published. scripts/release-linux.sh creates the tag on GitHub, fetches it back and prints `commit: <sha>` as its last line (FIBR-0184); set that sha as `commit:` in packaging/flatpak/io.github.milnet01.finbreak.yaml before submitting to Flathub. flatpak_packaging INV-4 asserts the commit is a 40-hex sha and INV-10 asserts the tag matches __version__, but nothing can verify the two point at the SAME object -- that is this todo.

Refresh the Flatpak pip closure before submitting to Flathub (FIBR-0298): with the venv active, run packaging/flatpak/generate-pip-sources.sh (online) and diff packaging/flatpak/python3-deps.yaml. An empty diff is the confirmation. A non-empty one means newer (possibly security-fixed) wheels exist: take them only after `LOCAL=0 packaging/flatpak/flatpak-build.sh` ends FINBREAK_SELFTEST_OK, then commit. Nothing else checks these wheels between releases.

Sync the deb changelog (FIBR-0155): prepend a stanza to packaging/obs/debian/changelog NON-INTERACTIVELY (not `dch` -- no TTY): first line `finbreak ({NEW}) unstable; urgency=medium`, then the [{NEW}] CHANGELOG bullets as `  * ` lines, then a ` -- Anthony Schemel <aant.schemel@gmail.com>  <RFC-2822 date>` trailer (DEBFULLNAME/DEBEMAIL match the release key owner). changelog-writer has no deb mode, so write it mechanically. Its version must equal __version__ (obs_packaging INV-6); post_check now gates this.
